prompt:
You write multiple-choice questions for a busy product owner. Each question settles one ambiguity in a test specification.

For each input question, write:
- key: copy it unchanged.
- text: one or two plain sentences: what is unclear and why it matters for testing. No jargon.
- choices: 2 to 4 options, each with a short id (a, b, c, d) and a one-line text. Base them on the given options; you may merge duplicates but not invent new behaviour.
- recommended: the id of the choice a careful product owner would most likely pick, preferring the safer, more conventional behaviour.

<questions>
[
 {
  "key": "4dae96a5e4545c13",
  "about": "intended behaviour",
  "why": "A reviewer rejected the code's current behaviour.",
  "options": [
   "Same generic message for both cases",
   "Leave to human judgement",
   "Out of scope: don't test this"
  ],
  "criterion_text": "Deactivated account login message depends on password correctness: given a deactivated account, when the user logs in with a wrong password, then with the correct password, then a wrong password gets 400 'Incorrect email or password'; the correct password gets 400 'Inactive user'"
 },
 {
  "key": "a674f45404a38848",
  "about": "token_lifetime",
  "why": "The story says about a week; the code issues tokens valid for 8 days.",
  "options": [
   "7 days",
   "8 days (current config)"
  ],
  "criterion_text": "Access token expires after about a week: given a user has received an access token, when about a week passes, then the access token expires and stops being valid"
 },
 {
  "key": "06122940dfdaeaa0",
  "about": "expired_token_status",
  "why": "The story does not say which status an expired token gets; the code returns 403.",
  "options": [
   "403 (current)",
   "401 Unauthorized"
  ],
  "criterion_text": "Expired token is refused and user must log in again: given a user holds an expired access token, when the user uses the expired token, then the token is refused and the user has to log in again"
 },
 {
  "key": "b6a0b7baa843e92b",
  "about": "other_user_item_status",
  "why": "403 reveals that the item exists; 404 would hide it.",
  "options": [
   "403 (current)",
   "404"
  ],
  "criterion_text": "User cannot see, change or delete other users' items: given a logged-in user and an item belonging to someone else, when the user tries to view, change or delete that item, then the user is not able to see, change or delete the item"
 },
 {
  "key": "66fd0ce7332fa181",
  "about": "default_page_size",
  "why": "The default is 100 items per page; the story only says reasonable.",
  "options": [
   "10",
   "20",
   "50",
   "100 (current)"
  ],
  "criterion_text": "Default page size is a reasonable number: given a user requests a page of items without specifying a size, when the page is returned, then the page shows a reasonable number of items"
 }
]
</questions>
